title: Kinetic Studio
line: My lab of motion-graphics trailers made in code: picture and sound are generated live in the browser.

facts.v: My own project, built with a trailer agent
Hub, trailers, engine, recipes and sound

film.alt: Excerpt of the KINETIC trailer: circle, square and triangle on cream paper changing colour and place.
film.label: Made in code

ten.v: Product trailers that are edited as data and can be reviewed frame by frame.
One paused master timeline drives picture and sound; scenes are recipes that return their duration, and the music is a list of notes.
31 trailers in a public hub on GitHub Pages, and this portfolio's «Meet Ignacio» trailer, built with its kit.

how.d: A trailer agent creates the folder with its own copy of the kit.
trailer.js names the scenes, palette, fonts and music.
The engine calls each recipe and adds everything to one timeline.
Every push to main builds the hub and publishes it on GitHub Pages.
In the hub, a poster and a silent preview on hover.

decisions.why: The film is deterministic and jumps to any second: frame-by-frame review with ?t=, hub previews and offline audio.
The same list of notes plays live, renders offline with a fixed seed and moves the picture on the beat.
Each scene's first frame is the costly one: the portfolio's trailer walks the film once behind a cover before playing.

kinetic-ritmo.caption: KINETIC: a dot grid pulsing with RHYTHM.

kinetic-profundidad.caption: KINETIC: geometric tunnel with DEPTH and SPEED.

lab-bauhaus.caption: Lab trailer "Bauhaus 100", recorded from a local build.

lab-hyperspace.caption: "Hyperspace" trailer: 3D scenes with Three.js.

more.p: The trailer is a static page of the kit inside a same-origin iframe. Audio is created inside the click and the iframe borrows it.
With the warm-up pass, the average frame of the portfolio's trailer went from 29 to 20 ms, a lab measurement in Chromium rendering in software.
The hash test opens the same second three ways: 2 of 4 moments come out identical bit for bit and the other two differ by one colour level.

next: Next step: unify the kit into one shared copy for every trailer.
